messages:
rob: Postmortem follow-up for customer Orion (Dedicated). Root causes: intermittent VPC peering blips + customer on-prem NAT ephemeral port exhaustion led to automated tenant isolation. Need owners for short mitigation, runbook, alerts, and test window. Packet captures + timeline in doc: https://intra.redwood/pm/orion-isol

anya: I'll own the short mitigation at the edge: add per-tenant reconnect cooldown + soft throttle. Plan: feature flag + minimal telemetry. ETA 2026-04-03 for PR.

taylor: I'll take the on-prem preflight/runbook (NAT table checks, ephemeral ranges, tcpdump steps). Will include exact commands and expected ranges. ETA 2026-03-31.

ops-bot: Created ticket ORN-4001: "Orion: on-prem preflight + runbook" assigned to support-team -> https://tracker.redwood/ORN-4001

maria: Eng-infra: please propose alert thresholds for BGP flaps and peer reauths so ops can page when needed.

infra-bot: ALERT-9155 created: "Orion: BGP flaps >4/10m or peer_reauths >100/min" -> https://tracker.redwood/ALERT-9155

anya: Mitigation details: cooldown window 60s after 5 failed reconnects; expose config per-dedicated-tenant. Will document rollback.

taylor: Runbook snippet I'll include:
```
# ephemeral ports usage
ss -s | grep ephemeral
# established connections
netstat -an | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
# quick capture
tcpdump -w /tmp/orion.pcap host <peer-ip>
```
I'll attach expected thresholds and escalation steps.

maria: Coordinating a joint test window with customer ops for week of 04/04. Need PR links + runbook by 2026-04-02 to schedule.

rob: Consolidated actions:
- A1: Edge cooldown & per-tenant throttle (short-term) - owner: anya - due: 2026-04-03 - ticket: ORN-4002
- A2: On-prem preflight & tcpdump runbook - owner: taylor - due: 2026-03-31 - ticket: ORN-4001
- A3: Ops alerts for BGP/peer_reauths - owner: eng-infra (ops) - alert: ALERT-9155
- A4: Joint test coordination - owner: maria - due: 2026-04-02

anya: I'll also add per-tenant metrics: peer_reauths/min and cooldown_triggered_count.

taylor: I'll include a checklist for customer NAT vendors (Cisco/Juniper) with recommended kernel tweaks.

rob: Weekly follow-up sync scheduled Thu 03/26 09:00 PT. Drop PRs and ticket updates here. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
